environment.description: Same Go Gin application deployed on ECS Fargate. Traffic routes through AWS API Gateway (HTTP API type) with a request model validator attached to the POST /api/v1/products/search route. The model schema defines 'category' as an enum type restricted to the values ['electronics', 'clothing', 'home', 'sports', 'books', 'toys'] and 'query' with a regex pattern constraint of '^[a-zA-Z0-9 ._-]{1,100}$'. Request validation mode is set to '$request.body' with validateRequestBody=true, causing API Gateway to return 400 for any request where the body does not conform to the JSON Schema before it reaches the backend. Note: the API Gateway validation occurs at the edge before any proxy integration invocation.

config.api_gateway: AWS API Gateway HTTP API (v2), route POST /api/v1/products/search
config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 15, appuser has SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on products schema
config.network: API Gateway -> VPC Link -> ALB (internal) -> ECS task -> RDS
